title: Beating Harmful Stereotypes Through Facts: RAG-based Counter-speech Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the quality, factuality, cogency, and effectiveness of RAG-augmented LLM counter-speech generated in response to hate speech targeting women, using automatic metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore), LLM-as-a-Judge (JudgeLM), and human evaluation.

Evaluating the quality, factuality, cogency, and effectiveness of RAG-augmented LLM counter-speech generated in response to hate speech targeting people of color (POC), using automatic metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore), LLM-as-a-Judge (JudgeLM), and human evaluation.

Evaluating the quality, factuality, cogency, and effectiveness of RAG-augmented LLM counter-speech generated in response to hate speech targeting Muslims (Islamophobia) and Jews (Antisemitism), using automatic metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore), LLM-as-a-Judge (JudgeLM), and human evaluation.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the quality, factuality, cogency, and effectiveness of RAG-augmented LLM counter-speech generated in response to hate speech targeting LGBT+ persons, using automatic metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore), LLM-as-a-Judge (JudgeLM), and human evaluation.

Evaluating the quality, factuality, cogency, and effectiveness of RAG-augmented LLM counter-speech generated in response to xenophobic hate speech targeting migrants, using automatic metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore), LLM-as-a-Judge (JudgeLM), and human evaluation.

Evaluating the quality, factuality, cogency, and effectiveness of RAG-augmented LLM counter-speech generated in response to ableist hate speech targeting persons with disabilities, using automatic metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore), LLM-as-a-Judge (JudgeLM), and human evaluation.
